title: Postpartum haemorrhage (primary + secondary, after vaginal birth)
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA guideline
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, k=kind (check|value|yn|info|sub), h=heading

admission.title: Diagnostic criteria — any one confirms PPH

items.t: Blood loss ≥ 500 mL within 24 h of birth — measured (drape) or appears excessive
Any blood loss with haemodynamic instability (tachycardia and/or hypotension)
Secondary PPH: fresh blood or clots > 24 h after birth
Do not wait for vital signs to change — treat at ≥ 500 mL
Birth time ____ · Loss ____ mL (drape / visual) · Time PPH ____ · Para ____

admission.title: Massive bleeding / refer = any one of

items.t: Reduced level of consciousness · cold peripheries
Still bleeding after MOTIVE + cause-directed treatment (refractory)
Likely to need more than the 2 units on site
Retained placenta or products needing theatre
Complex / cervical tear, apex not reached (? rupture)

admission.title: Maternity case record (antenatal card + delivery notes)

items.t: Oxytocin 10 U IM at birth — time
Severe pain / shock out of proportion

admission.title: Vitals and measurements
admission.note: Abnormal = outside adult norms or her own booking values

items.t: Total so far: ____ mL (drape / weighed pads / visual)
> 1500 mL: massive bleeding protocol — 2 O-neg + 2 FDP, call for transfer
Visual estimates underestimate — measure every 15 min
Warning sign for patient: > 2–3 pads soaked in 20–30 min
Hb on arrival: ____ g/dL · clot test ____
Early Hb can be falsely reassuring — treat the bleeding and the vitals
Bleeding + shock: 2 O-neg units + 2 units FDP (severe haemorrhage), give now
Clot test fails, or oozing from drip sites → coagulopathy → REFER
Send FBC, group & cross-match sample with the transfer

admission.title: Red flags to rule out on arrival

decision.t: 10. Diagnosis = MASSIVE / REFRACTORY PPH or needs theatre (§2) → MOTIVE, bimanual or balloon tamponade, TXA, 2 O-neg + 2 FDP, then REFER (BP and pulse stabilised, escorted)
11. PPH CONTROLLED with MOTIVE + cause-directed treatment → ADMIT — stabilise, then continue on the PPH management chart and the 12-hour PPH nursing record.

chart.phase_note: Clock starts when PPH is diagnosed (≥ 500 mL). ANDH: 2 O-neg units + FDP, no blood bank, no theatre or evacuation → REFER early.

standing.t: While bleeding / on uterotonics: BP, pulse, uterus and blood loss every 15 min · shock index (HR ÷ SBP) · cumulative blood loss (drape / weighed pads)
After control: BP, pulse, RR, temp, pads, uterus every 15 min × 1 h, then every 30 min × 1 h
Then 4-hourly on the early warning chart
Level of consciousness · temp — keep > 35 °C · IV fluid and blood in
Act on: SBP < 80 · HR > 120 · shock index > 1.5 · loss > 1500 mL · reduced LOC · cold peripheries

rows.label: 0 min
rows.lead: Call for help and the PPH box. Check what was given before (oxytocin, TXA doses — max 2) †. Talk to her calmly throughout.

feed.t: Shocked: 2nd line, NaCl 0.9% or RL run fast — 1–2 L, max 2–3 L crystalloid
Oxygen by face mask if shocked

tests.t: Hb (meter); FBC, group & cross-match (goes with transfer)

treatment.t: Massage uterus, expel clots
Oxytocin 10 U in 100–200 mL NaCl 0.9% IV over 5–10 min (no IV yet: 10 U IM)
Tranexamic acid 1 g in 200 mL IV over 10 min — separate bag (caution VTE / heart valves)
Then oxytocin 20 U in 1 L NaCl 0.9% at 125–250 mL/h
Fluids as above; blood when shocked
Examine: tone, tissue, trauma, thrombin (4 Ts)
Escalate: senior doctor now; if massive → phone referral hospital + EMS early
Give the 2 O-neg units + 2 units FDP now; activate transfer
Atony: ergometrine 0.5 mg IM (or ergometrine/oxytocin 1 ampoule IM) unless HT / cardiac; keep massaging
Tear: repair under local in lithotomy; complex → REFER
Retained placenta / inversion: cause-specific box

feed.t: Continue fluids; O-neg blood if shocked

treatment.t: Bimanual uterine compression
Ergometrine 0.5 mg IM — one repeat dose
Misoprostol 600 µg SL or PR, single dose
Tranexamic acid 1 g IV, 2nd (last) dose
Atony, trauma and tissue excluded: uterine balloon tamponade; bleeding past the balloon or still bleeding after 10 min → remove, next step

feed.t: Up to 3 L crystalloid; 2 O-neg units + 2 FDP; warm fluids

tests.t: SBP < 80, HR > 120, shock index > 1.5, loss > 1500 mL, ↓LOC

treatment.t: Aortic compression above the umbilicus while waiting
Needs theatre, more blood, platelets or laparotomy → REFER now; senior doctor at receiving hospital phoned

feed.t: Lines running; blood going; keep warm

tests.t: Notes, bloods, blood forms go with her

treatment.t: Temporise: balloon tamponade (atony) or vaginal packing (lacerations)
BP and pulse as stable as possible before leaving; ambulance within 30 min; escort doctor / midwife
Explain to her and family why

tests.t: 15 min × 1 h, 30 min × 1 h: BP, pulse, RR, temp, pads, uterus

treatment.t: Rebleeding → back to 0 min
Balloon in: keep, oxytocin running, reassess for removal
Skin-to-skin and breastfeeding when stable

feed.t: Oral fluids, light meal; stop IV when stable

tests.t: Hourly BP, pulse, pads, uterus, urine

treatment.t: Remove catheter when stable and mobile
Paracetamol 1 g PO for pain
Debrief kindly; offer support

tests.t: BP, pulse, temp, pads 4-hourly (early warning chart)

treatment.t: Rh-neg + baby Rh-pos/unknown: anti-D 100 µg IM ≤ 72 h
After manual removal: antibiotics (box)
Hb < 6 or symptomatic: transfuse / REFER if no blood left

tests.t: All results: Hb, syphilis, Rh, HIV

treatment.t: Hb 8–9.9: ferrous sulphate compound 170 mg (or ferrous fumarate 200 mg) 12-hourly
Hb ≤ 7.9: ferrous sulphate 200 mg 8-hourly + folic acid 5 mg daily
Contraception; debrief; mental health screen

feed.t: Resuscitate as primary PPH; oxytocin 20 U in 1 L NaCl 0.9% at 125 mL/h

tests.t: LOC, temp, colour, BP, pulse, RR

treatment.t: Oxytocin 10 U IM single dose
Ergometrine 0.5 mg IM once unless HT / cardiac
Admit

tests.t: Speculum + bimanual: retained products, wound, haematoma
Sepsis signs: temp, pulse, offensive lochia, tender uterus

treatment.t: Sepsis: amoxicillin/clavulanic acid 1.2 g IV 8-hourly → 875/125 mg PO 12-hourly
Retained products → evacuation in theatre → REFER
Severe sepsis (temp ≥ 37.5 + pulse ≥ 100) → REFER

items.t: 10 U in 100–200 mL NaCl 0.9% IV over 5–10 min (or 10 U IM)
Infusion 20 U in 1 L NaCl 0.9% at 125–250 mL/h (4–8 h)
0.5 mg IM (or ergometrine/oxytocin 1 ampoule IM); one repeat after 15 min
Not in hypertension or cardiac disease
600 µg SL or PR, single dose
1 g in 200 mL IV over 10 min; repeat once after 30 min — max 2 doses; caution VTE / heart valves
2 un-cross-matched O-neg units + 2 units FDP (all severe obstetric haemorrhage); FDP and FFP interchangeable; then REFER. Rh-neg given Rh-pos blood → anti-D per specialist
Bleeding: catheter, oxytocin infusion, manual removal in labour ward now
Minimal bleeding: oxytocin infusion; manual removal is a theatre procedure → REFER; CCT if it separates
After manual removal: ampicillin 1 g IV, then amoxicillin 500 mg + metronidazole 400 mg PO 8-hourly × 5 days
Repair in lithotomy under local; complex / cervical apex not seen → pack, REFER
NaCl 0.9% fast via 2 × 16 G; morphine 0.1 mg/kg IM (max 10 mg) if SBP ≥ 90; do not remove attached placenta
Salbutamol 250 µg IV; push fundus up and hold; failing → hydrostatic (500–1000 mL saline in vagina)
After reduction: ergometrine 0.5 mg IM + oxytocin 20 U/1 L at 240 mL/h; failed → REFER
Refractory PPH · need beyond 2 O-neg units · massive bleeding triggers
Manual removal / evacuation in theatre · complex tear · ? rupture
Failed inversion reduction · coagulopathy · severe sepsis
All treatment available here given; balloon / packing in; BP and pulse stabilised; escort; notes, bloods, blood forms
Stop, new line NaCl 0.9%, check ID, call doctor; return unit + set to blood bank
Loss ≥ 500 mL · soft uterus · SBP < 80 · HR > 120 · shock index > 1.5 · ↓LOC · cold peripheries · temp < 35 · poor urine output (†) · rebleeding

discharge.title: Discharge criteria — all must be met

items.t: No active bleeding; uterus firm, not tender
Hb recorded; iron and folic acid prescribed
Hb, syphilis, Rh, HIV recorded and acted on
Discharge summary: PPH, blood given, next pregnancy risk
Clinic at 3–6 days, then 6 weeks (bedside Hb; FBC if low). Mental health screen; offer debriefing support.
> 2–3 pads soaked in 20–30 min or bleeding increasing, fever, severe abdominal pain, fast breathing, too weak to stand

nursing.title: 12-hour PPH nursing record — vitals, uterus, blood loss, urine
nursing.period: One sheet per 12 hours from PPH; 15-min rows × 2 h, 30-min rows to 4 h, hourly to 12 h; rebleeding → new sheet

items.t: Every 15 min while bleeding / on uterotonics, and for 1 h after control
Then every 30 min × 1 h, then hourly × 8 h (†)
Uterus firm (F) or soft (S) — soft: massage and call
Blood loss each check (drape / weighed pads) + running total
Record every IV bag and blood unit
Temp and AVPU with each set; keep warm (> 35 °C)

call.t: Call the doctor for blood loss ≥ 500 mL · soft uterus · SBP < 80 · pulse > 120 · shock index > 1.5 · reduced LOC · cold peripheries · temp < 35 · poor urine output (†) · any rebleeding · transfusion reaction
